title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper

Mark eagerly dates Teresa (ROXANNE BECKFORD), an attractive schoolteacher, until he learns that her father is Coach Ricketts.

When Mark takes a temporary job in an office mail room, he is quickly promoted to an executive position. MARCUS ALLEN guest stars as himself.

Robin and Vanessa win dates with handsome bachelors on a television game show while Mark spends Valentine's Day at home.

Moesha’s father arranges a reunion of Moesha’s childhood playgroup (his motive is to sell Saturns).

Moesha reports on the annual school “ditch day”, but will not reveal who attended or who her sources are.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E17 — Everybody Hates The Ex-Cons
Chris attempts to help Malvo, a criminal who was recently released from jail, turn his life around by going back to high school. Rochelle is alarmed by the parenting skills of one of Tonya's friend's parents and decides to share her wealth of knowledge.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E18 — Everybody Hates Mother's Day
Chris decides to buy his mother an expensive bottle of perfume for Mother's Day to pay her back for all the things she has done for him, but when he learns that it costs much more than he anticipated, Chris buys an imposter version of the perfume.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E19 — Everybody Hates The First Kiss
After finding out that Tasha is going to 'spin the bottle' parties, Chris is determined to get an invitation to the next party so he can finally experience his first kiss.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E20 — Everybody Hates Easter
When Tasha breaks up with her boyfriend, Chris is more than happy to step in and serve as her escort for the Easter Pageant, but first, he has to figure out how to be in two places at the same time without his mother finding out.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E16 — The Big Reality Bites Episode
Dee Dee's new actor boyfriend tells her he's going to star in a new reality dating show and asks her to join in the fun. Things become difficult when Dee Dee realizes she must compete for his attention.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E17 — The Big Stuck In The Middle Episode
Mona convinces Chase to hire Lorenzo as a pastry chef at City Sonoma. Chase becomes furious with Mona for not informing him that Lorenzo is her ex-boyfriend.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E18 — The Big What Have We Done Episode
After finding out her rival will be writing her six-month performance review for the agency, Dee Dee makes an effort to tighten up her relationship with Brett outside the office. T.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E19 — The Big Nervous Break Up Episode
While Chase is out of town on a business trip, Lorenzo shares with Mona that he still has feelings for her. Although Mona remains committed to Chase, she begins to fantasize about Lorenzo.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E19 — Pros and Convicts
When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E1 — Call Me Irresponsible
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E2 — My Bodyguard
Mark teaches Tyler how to be a tough guy so that he can protect Nicole against a bully at school. When Tyler's approach doesn't work, Geneva goes up to the school and makes a big scene, scaring the bully away. Vanessa takes care of her boss' prized orchid.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E3 — Between Friends
Mark and a former college buddy embark upon an all-out competition--first with wrestling, then with women. Vanessa finally manages to get a job answering phones at a doctor's office.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E4 — He Said, She Said
Geneva fights with the video store clerk who claims that she never returned the "Mrs. Doubtfire" tape. When Mark breaks up with a woman he was dating from Vanessa's carpool, Vanessa is kicked out.
